cohort: The study included 3,867 singleton mothers and their neonates from a tertiary maternity hospital in Zhejiang Province, conceived either naturally or through ART.
finding: ART-conceived neonates demonstrated a lower risk of NICU admission compared to naturally conceived neonates, potentially due to optimized prenatal care and embryo selection.
mod_finding: ART-conceived neonates had higher cesarean section rates and delivery mode was found to mediate some of the observed effects.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, with ART-conceived neonates having lower birth weights.
gest_age: Measured as an outcome, with ART-conceived neonates having shorter gestational weeks.
